name: Reijou Maid Chizuru
source:
“Yoshikazu,” the Himesaki family's educator, gains the seat of the Lord by the sudden death of his brother. He uses that power to put some of his ambitions into practice. The ambitions were revenge on Chizuru, the only daughter of the Himesaki family, who has been bullying him for years. What method will he chose to make Chizuru surrender her body and mind to him? And what future is waiting for Chizuru?

[Translated and edited from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=753137]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
姬崎家的教育家“义和”因哥哥的突然去世而登上了领主的位置。他利用这种力量将他的一些抱负付诸实践。野心是向多年来欺负他的姬崎家的独生女千鹤报仇。他会选择怎样的方法，让千鹤将身心交托给他呢？而等待着千鹤的未来又是什么呢？

[翻译和编辑自 [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=753137]Getchu[/url]]
